metadata.short_desc: Reply only on an exact trigger match; group trigger configurable
metadata.desc: Replies only when a message exactly matches a trigger, avoiding substring false triggers. Supports multiple trigger-and-reply rules, each of which can require a bot mention in group chats.

rules.hint: Each rule is a trigger-and-reply group. The reply is sent only when the message exactly matches the trigger; for example, “hello” does not match “hello there”.

exact_rule.name: Match rule
exact_rule.hint: Sends the reply when the trigger matches exactly.

trigger.hint: Message text that must match exactly, without the wake prefix. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored; matching is case-sensitive.

bot_id.hint: Enter the Bot ID shown in the platform settings. The bot account ID also works. Leave empty to apply to all bots.

require_wake.hint: Enabled by default. When enabled, this rule only matches in group chats when the bot is mentioned or the wake prefix is used. When disabled, sending the trigger directly in a group also replies. Private chats are unaffected.

response.hint: Sent directly on a match without calling the model; line breaks are supported.
